children: UK protective equipment maker's preliminary FY26 revenue rose 12.7%, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBIT and pretax profit for FY26 beat analyst expectations
Company completed STAR transformation, driving improved operational performance and profitability
Avon Technologies expects mid-single-digit revenue growth in FY27
Company expects FY27 adjusted operating profit margin in the 16-18% range
Company sees FY27 free cash flow of about $50-60m
STRONG DEMAND - Co said revenue growth was driven by record filter volumes in Avon Protection and higher production rates in Team Wendy
TRANSFORMATION BENEFITS - Co attributed margin and profit growth to operational improvements and productivity gains from the STAR transformation programme
COST SAVINGS & ONE-OFFS - IT transformation, cost control, and one-off items such as US tariff refunds contributed to profit growth
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the aerospace & defense peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Avon Technologies PLC is GBp2,500.00, about 4.2% above its November 9 closing price of GBp2,400.00
The stock recently traded at 21 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 17 three months ago
